# Jeremiah 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD spoke to me:

**2** "Go and announce this to everyone in Jerusalem. Tell them the LORD says: 'I remember how devoted you were to Me when you were young — how you loved Me like a bride, following Me through the wilderness, through a land where nothing grows.

**3** Israel belonged to the LORD then — the first portion of His harvest. Anyone who tried to consume them paid the price; disaster fell on them,' declares the LORD."

**4** Listen to the LORD's message, descendants of Jacob — every family of Israel.

**5** The LORD says: "What did your ancestors find wrong with Me that they walked away and chased after worthless things until they became worthless themselves?

**6** They never even asked, 'Where is the LORD — the one who rescued us from Egypt and led us through the wilderness, through a landscape of deserts and ravines, drought and death-shadow, where nobody travels and nobody lives?'

**7** I brought you into a rich, fertile land to enjoy its abundance. But the moment you arrived, you polluted My land and turned My inheritance into something disgusting.

**8** The priests never asked, 'Where is the LORD?' The legal experts didn't know Me. The leaders rebelled against Me. The prophets prophesied in Baal's name and chased things with no power at all.

**9** So I will keep pressing charges against you," declares the LORD, "and against your grandchildren after you.

**10** Travel west to the coasts of Cyprus. Send east to the desert tribes of Kedar. Look carefully and see if anything like this has ever happened:

**11** Has any nation ever traded its gods for new ones — even though those gods aren't real? Yet My people have traded away their glorious God for things that are completely useless.

**12** Be stunned by this, heavens! Be absolutely horrified!" declares the LORD.

**13** "My people have committed two crimes: They've abandoned Me — the spring of fresh, living water — and instead they've dug their own wells, cracked wells that can't even hold water.

**14** Is Israel a slave? Was he born into servitude? Then why has he become everyone's prey?

**15** Lions have roared over him and devastated his land. His cities lie in smoking ruins, completely empty.

**16** Even the Egyptians from Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked open your skull.

**17** Haven't you done this to yourself by abandoning the LORD your God while He was leading you?

**18** So what's the point of running to Egypt to drink from the Nile? What's the point of running to Assyria to drink from the Euphrates?

**19** Your own wickedness will punish you. Your own unfaithfulness will correct you. Think about it — see how evil and bitter it is to abandon the LORD your God and have no reverence for Me at all," declares the Lord GOD of Armies.

**20** "Long ago I freed you from slavery — I broke your chains. But you said, 'I won't serve You!' On every hilltop and under every green tree, you threw yourself down like a prostitute.

**21** I planted you as a premium grapevine from the finest stock. How did you turn into a wild, worthless vine?

**22** Even if you scrubbed yourself with industrial cleaner and poured on the soap, the stain of your guilt would still be visible to Me," declares the Lord GOD.

**23** "How dare you claim, 'I'm not contaminated — I haven't worshiped the Baals'? Look at what you've done in the valley! You're like a restless young camel, running in circles,

**24** Or a wild donkey in heat, sniffing the wind, impossible to control. Males don't even have to chase her — she comes to them.

**25** I told you, 'Stop running until your feet are raw and your throat is parched!' But you said, 'It's no use. I love these foreign gods, and I'm going after them.'

**26** Just as a thief is disgraced when they're caught, the people of Israel will be disgraced — kings, officials, priests, prophets, all of them —

**27** People who call a wooden pole 'Father' and a stone idol 'Mother.' They've turned their backs on Me, not their faces. But the instant trouble comes, they cry out, 'Save us!'

**28** Where are those gods you manufactured? Let them rescue you when disaster strikes! You have as many gods as you have cities, Judah.

**29** Why are you arguing with Me? Every one of you has rebelled," declares the LORD.

**30** I disciplined your people, but it was wasted effort — they refused to learn. Your own swords killed your prophets like a lion tearing prey apart.

**31** People of this generation, pay attention to what the LORD says! Have I been a desert to Israel? A land of darkness? Then why do My people say, 'We're free! We're done with You!'?

**32** Does a young woman forget her jewelry? Does a bride forget her wedding dress? But My people have forgotten Me — for more days than anyone can count.

**33** You've become an expert at chasing after lovers! You're so skilled at it that you could teach the worst women your tricks.

**34** The blood of innocent poor people stains your clothes — and they weren't even caught committing a crime. Despite all this evidence,

**35** You still say, 'I'm innocent — God can't be angry with me anymore.' Watch — I am putting you on trial right now for claiming, 'I haven't sinned.'

**36** Why do you keep changing direction — running to one ally, then another? Egypt will humiliate you just the way Assyria did.

**37** You'll leave there too with your hands on your head in shame, because the LORD has rejected everyone you're counting on. They won't help you at all.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **2:5-6**: God's pain is palpable — 'What did I do wrong?' He gave them everything, and they never even asked where He went. It's the wound of a rejected lover.

- **2:13**: One of the most powerful images in the entire Bible — people abandoning a spring of fresh water to dig their own cracked wells. It's the definition of insanity.

- **2:27**: Calling a tree 'Father' and a stone 'Mother' — and then running to the real God only when disaster strikes. The hypocrisy is stunning.

— PNEUMA
